items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I might don't slip my remembrance, you know. You know all them times, it's been some time. Yeah. I done been through a whole lot. What are they called? Fireman George? Yeah, Fireman George.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was rough there. Where was that? What's that? In the district. In the district there. What was the name of that place? They had a whole fella, they had that place, they called him Papa. Papa's place. I know what I'm going to ask you. Do you remember Farmer
George? Fireman George? He used to have a parade with one colored fireman here, and he'd go out and have a parade himself by himself. Nobody else, just him.

I might don't slip my remembrance, you know. You know all them times, it's been some time. Yeah. I done been through a whole lot. What are they called? Fireman George? Yeah, Fireman George. What are you playing?
